title: Create AlertManager service with basic alert CRUD operations
documentation: Create new backend service alertManager.ts with methods: createAlert, getActiveAlerts, dismissAlert. Alerts stored in-memory for now (Map<string, Alert>). Simple Alert type with id, chainId, reason, timestamp, dismissed fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Alerts stored in Map with unique IDs
Add unit tests for all methods

title: Add stuck task detection to alertManager
documentation: Add checkStuckTasks method to alertManager.ts that creates alerts for tasks running >60 minutes. Method should be called periodically. Alert includes task_id, duration, and reason='stuck_task'.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates one alert per stuck task (no duplicates)
Alert includes task duration and ID
Add unit test with mock task data

title: Add GET /api/dev-bots/alerts endpoint
documentation: Create new route file alerts.routes.ts with single GET /alerts endpoint. Returns active alerts from alertManager. Simple route, no complex logic.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /alerts returns active alerts as JSON
Returns 200 with empty array if no alerts

title: Add POST /api/dev-bots/alerts/:id/dismiss endpoint
documentation: Add POST /alerts/:id/dismiss endpoint to alerts.routes.ts. Calls alertManager.dismissAlert(id). Returns updated alert or 404 if not found.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 200 with dismissed alert on success
Alert no longer in active alerts after dismiss

title: Create AlertsPanel component to display alerts
documentation: Create new React component AlertsPanel.tsx in components/common/ that fetches and displays active alerts. Simple list with alert reason, timestamp, and dismiss button. No complex interactions yet. Component should use Card from @/components/ui/card, Button from @/components/ui/button, and Badge from @/components/ui/badge for consistent styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays alerts in a list with reason and time

title: Add alert count badge to DevBotsTabContent header
documentation: Add small badge to DevBotsTabContent showing active alert count. Badge fetches count from alerts API. Red background when count > 0. Clicking opens alerts panel. Update the existing DevBotsTabContent component in frontend/src/components/monitor/tabs/DevBotsTabContent.tsx to include this badge in the header area. Use Badge component from @/components/ui/badge.
acceptanceCriteria: Badge shows alert count in header
Badge red when count > 0, gray when 0

title: Add pause/resume state to taskQueue service
documentation: Add isPaused boolean state to taskQueue.sqlite.ts. Add pause() and resume() methods. When paused, processNextTask should skip processing. State should persist to database.
acceptanceCriteria: pause() method sets isPaused to true
resume() method sets isPaused to false

title: Add GET /api/dev-bots/queue/status endpoint
documentation: Create queue.routes.ts with GET /queue/status endpoint. Returns queue state: isPaused, pendingCount, processingCount. Simple read-only endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns pending and processing task counts

title: Add POST /api/dev-bots/queue/pause endpoint
documentation: Add POST /queue/pause endpoint to queue.routes.ts. Calls taskQueue.pause(). Returns updated queue status.
acceptanceCriteria: Subsequent tasks don't process after pause

title: Add POST /api/dev-bots/queue/resume endpoint
documentation: Add POST /queue/resume endpoint to queue.routes.ts. Calls taskQueue.resume(). Returns updated queue status.

title: Create QueueControls component with pause/resume buttons
documentation: Create QueueControls.tsx component in frontend/src/components/dev-bots/queue/ with pause and resume buttons. Fetches queue status and calls pause/resume endpoints. Shows current state (paused/active). Use Button from @/components/ui/button and Badge from @/components/ui/badge. Follow the pattern used in existing queue components like TaskQueuePanel.tsx and ChainStatusPanel.tsx.

title: Create ChainDetailsModal component skeleton
documentation: Create minimal ChainDetailsModal.tsx component in frontend/src/components/dev-bots/queue/ that opens when chain row is clicked. Modal shows chain ID, PR link, and close button. Keyboard accessible (Esc closes). Use Dialog components from @/components/ui (radix-ui based). Reference the existing modal patterns in the codebase. No complex data yet - this is just the skeleton structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal opens from chain row click
Shows chain ID and PR link
Close button and Esc key close modal
Focus trapped in modal when open

title: Add task history section to ChainDetailsModal
documentation: Extend ChainDetailsModal.tsx in frontend/src/components/dev-bots/queue/ to show last 5 tasks for the chain. Display task title, status, and timestamp. Simple read-only list. Use Badge from @/components/ui/badge for status display. Reference getTaskStatusColor and getTaskStatusIcon from @/utils/statusHelpers for consistent status rendering.
acceptanceCriteria: Modal fetches last 5 tasks for chain
Shows 'No tasks' if chain has no tasks

title: Add GET /api/dev-bots/sessions/recent endpoint
documentation: Add GET /sessions/recent endpoint to interactive.routes.ts. Returns last 10 interactive sessions with id, created_at, and context preview (first 100 chars). Ordered by created_at desc.
acceptanceCriteria: Each session includes id, created_at, context_preview
Context preview is first 100 chars of context_snapshot
Returns empty array if no sessions

title: Create SessionHistoryList component to display recent sessions
documentation: Create SessionHistoryList.tsx in frontend/src/components/dev-bots/interactive/ that fetches and displays last 10 sessions from GET /api/dev-bots/sessions/recent. Shows timestamp and context preview. Each row clickable to resume session. Use Card, Button, and ScrollArea from @/components/ui. Reference existing interactive components like InteractiveTerminal.tsx and InteractiveSessionTab.tsx for consistent patterns. Use formatRelativeTime from @/utils/dateFormatters for timestamps.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays sessions in list with timestamp and preview
List keyboard navigable with arrow keys
